title: Kodungaiyur Police head to Madurai in search of gang which assaulted MTC conductor
summary: On Friday (November 13) evening, while Mr. Nithyananda, the victim, was standing outside the Kannadasan Nagar bus depot, a gang assaulted him with knives.

title: IPL founder Lalit Modi acquires British citizenship, calls it ‘home for many years’
summary: In his post, accompanied by images from the citizenship ceremony at a Town Hall in London back in September, Mr. Modi on November 14 said he had chosen to publicly share the “very special and personal milestone” at his address at Oxford Union

title: Thrissur Pooram disruption probe faces fresh hurdle as Home Department rejects SIT report
summary: The SIT had sought permission to register cases against 10 persons, including Thiruvambady Devaswom office-bearers, on charges including conspiracy and hurting religious sentiments.

title: William and Kate visit Mumbai for Earthshot Prize ceremony
summary: The visit focuses on the annual Earthshot Prize and also will involve events on gully cricket and an engagement with the film industry

title: Andhra Pradesh local body polls: TDP-led NDA wrests 12 of 13 Mayor posts; Anantapur only solace for YSRCP
summary: TDP wins 2,571 of 3,897 wards for which poll results have been declared, while YSRCP secures 550 wards, JSP emerges victorious in 484 wards, and BJP grabs 153 wards; counting for Chirala municipality postponed to November 6

title: NDA candidates will win Panchayat elections also: R&B Minister Janardhan Reddy
summary: During the meeting, discussions were held about regarding the strategy for the Panchayat elections, coordination among the alliance parties at the village level, active participation of leaders and workers and election preparedness

title: Assam Congress writes to PM, seeks enhanced aid for victims of Kaziranga accident
summary: In the letter, Debabrata Saikia expressed concern over the deplorable condition of the National Highway-715 stretch and alleged that the authorities' neglect of essential road safety measures was disturbing

title: Mizoram village revels in return of World War II-hit festival
summary: Serkawn hosts the three-day Leitlangpui Music Festival, initiating a series of winter tourism events planned to crescendo with Christmas and New Year
